_comment: Targeted questions for the device's own dyld shared cache (CLAUDE.md
evidence source 1). Run by scripts/runner/device_evidence.py inside the
device-evidence job, which already holds the extracted cache: a separate
evidence-query workflow would have to re-download and re-decompress ~5 GB
<CACHE> is substituted with the cache path. 'grep' narrows the output,
because a full UIKitCore class dump is far larger than anything that
should be committed. Output is derived text about Apple's system
libraries; the cache never leaves the runner.

Two invocation bugs were fixed after the nonce-4 run: `ipsw dyld objc class` takes a single positional argument (the cache), so per-class queries must instead grep an `ipsw dyld macho <image> --objc` dump; and each grep must be anchored on the class declaration, because an unanchored @property pattern matches tens of thousands of lines in UIKitCore and is truncated long before the class of interest.

queries.why: Sanity check on the cache and a record of its header.
Phase 1's biggest launch risk: whether tvOS Metal accepts Roblox's iOS-compiled metallib blobs. Looks for the loader entry point in the device's Metal.
Phase 1: whether the device's CoreUI refuses an asset catalog whose deploymentPlatform is ios.

Phase 6 click-to-tap preference 2 sets a synthesized UITouch's location, window, view and phase. Those are private ivars, so their names on tvOS 27.2 must come from the device. Anchored on the class declaration this time: the previous broad @property pattern matched 36,320 lines and was truncated before UITouch appeared.
A synthesized touch is carried by a UIEvent; same private-ivar question.
Cross-check the nib-class finding against the class dump: UIDatePicker is exported by the device's UIKit and by tvOS SDK 27.2's UIKit.tbd, so it should appear here with its real superclass.
Confirm on the device, not just in the SDK, that the two classes the cursor depends on exist: GCEventViewController (focus-engine bypass) and GCMicroGamepad (the Siri Remote profile).
Evidence source 5: the dyld version this device ships, to compare against the dyld-1378 source the proxy mechanism was checked against. The previous search term 'dyld-1' matched only its own prefix.
Evidence source 5: the objc4 version this device ships. The previous term 'objc4-' returned nothing.
